en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a view across a river toward a hillside with trees and several buildings. On top of the hill stands a large historic castle complex with multiple gabled roofs and towers, identified in the caption as Schloss Nossen (east side). In the foreground are smaller houses or farm buildings near the riverbank. The lower margin contains printed German text including the castle name and the publisher information.
